description: This file defines the InboundEmailController class, which manages actions related to inbound email configuration and view handling within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for editing email settings and setting default outbound email servers.

classes.name: InboundEmailController
classes.description: Controller class for handling inbound email related actions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Prepares the view for editing inbound email settings, handling permissions and initializing email import settings.

methods.name: action_SetDefault
methods.description: Sets the default outbound email server for a user or the current user, then redirects to the appropriate view.
